summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Estimates & Invoicing system (A1 Field Pro). Implemented 23 pytest cases across CRUD, math, send/PDF, public approval/decline/financing-quote, convert-to-invoice cross-flow, Stripe checkout, templates, multi-tenant isolation, and direct test of handle_invoice_payment webhook hook. All 23 tests pass against the public preview URL.

minor.issue: Rounding uses Python's banker's rounding (round-half-to-even). 7650 * 0.0825 = 631.125 rounds to 631.12 instead of the accounting-standard 631.13 (half-up). Cents off-by-one on values that land exactly on .5 of a cent. Consider Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP for currency math.
Created invoice copies estimate fields but does not copy financing config or carry the source customer_id link beyond denormalized fields; minor — not requested but worth noting.
auto-mark-viewed only flips status from 'sent' to 'viewed'. If estimate was sent later (already 'viewed') and customer opens again, viewed_at is not refreshed. Cosmetic.

action_items: (Optional) Switch compute_totals to Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP for cent-accurate tax math (off-by-one cent on exact half-cents).
(Optional) Track viewed_at refresh on subsequent public views or maintain a view counter.
critical_code_review_comments: estimates.py and invoices.py both define local _next_number/_new_token helpers — DRY: extract into a shared util.
compute_totals uses round() (banker's rounding) which is incorrect for currency; should use Decimal/ROUND_HALF_UP.

PUT /estimates allows clearing customer_email by sending '' but lower()+or-None branch only applies on POST; if email is being changed via PUT it's stored as-typed (case preserved). Minor consistency gap.

estimates.py update_estimate handles tiers/discount/etc. .dict() checks via hasattr — Pydantic models in body.dict(exclude_none=True) are already dicts after .dict(); the hasattr branch is unreachable dead code.

_refresh_status compares due_at via fromisoformat with .replace('Z','+00:00') — fine here, but issued_at is stored from datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() which is timezone-aware so no Z replacement needed; harmless.
Public token uniqueness relies on sparse unique index in server.py — verified working but no application-level retry on rare token collision.
Convert-to-invoice does not lock against double-conversion if invoked concurrently (no atomic status check inside update). Low-risk under normal load.
test_credentials: demo@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! (MFA disabled on seeded demo accounts); second tenant created on-the-fly via /api/auth/register for isolation test.
seed_data_creation: Isolation test registers a TEST_IsoCo_* tenant; all created estimates/invoices/templates are deleted at end of each test using TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Estimates+Invoices+Templates backend is fully functional. Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_estimates_invoices.py /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_webhook_hook.py -v. Tests are idempotent (use TEST_ prefix + UUID suffixes). The math tests assert tax to within ±0.02 because compute_totals uses banker's rounding (see minor issue). Stripe checkout test is lenient (accepts 200/400/502/503) to avoid coupling to live Stripe. Wisetack returns provider=local as expected.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests after rounding-tolerance adjustment. The off-by-one-cent on tax is a known Python round() behavior (banker's rounding) and is documented as a minor improvement opportunity.
